title: 3 SPEED AUTO TRANS-INSTALLATION PROCEDURE
summary: Automatic transmission (M40) installation to the engine: torque converter to flexplate (flywheel) bolts and the converter underpan (flywheel/converter dust cover, inspection cover) at the bottom of the bellhousing. Bolts go through the flexplate into the threaded lugs (retainers) on the torque converter; the underpan is held to the bellhousing with screw assemblies. Bellhousing locates on the engine dowels.

parts.name: UNDERPAN ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Underpan assembly - converter/flywheel dust cover (inspection cover)

fastening.to: torque converter (retainers, part of converter asm.)
fastening.note: Bolts [3] go from the engine side through the flywheel (flexplate) into the threaded retainers on the converter; three bolt positions shown. Hand start all converter bolts before torquing.
Underpan [1] covers the lower bellhousing opening and is held by screw assemblies [2].

notes: CAUTION Hand start all converter bolts prior to torquing.
notes_internal: Flywheel and dowels are tagged with filled squares (production parts, no callout); flywheel listed by name in fastening.
